title: Sale prices
label: Premium demand
body: New West Zone — Bodakdev, Thaltej and Satellite — continues to command the highest sale prices. South-East and parts of East remain the more accessible entry points for first-time buyers.

title: Rental trends
label: Tenant demand
body: Professionals cluster along SG Highway. Gota and Chandlodiya offer newer stock at lower rents than Bodakdev; Navrangpura remains the established campus-side rental pocket.

title: Investment outlook
label: City-wide
body: Appreciation is strongest where Metro, highway access and employment overlap. Yield-focused investors still look at Nikol, Vastral and selected east-side pockets.
